provenance.command: git archive 981d25c | tar -x -C <oracle>; add scratch in-package capture test cmd/server/zz_ops_capture_test.go; cd <oracle>; GOLDEN_OUT=<out> FROZEN_DIR=<repo>/crates/sdk/humanymous-core/tests/scoring/fixtures/frozen GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go test -count=1 -run ^TestZZOpsCapture$ ./cmd/server/
capture_notes: exchanges go through newTestApp(t, false).routes() (or handleCounters directly for the controller cases) with httptest; status, Content-Type and body bytes are recorded, other headers are not

stored_reports are the six humanymous-core frozen scoring fixtures, decoded into signals.SessionReport, stored with store.StoreScored under the fixture id and read back with store.Get (Go JSON of the stored value)
a.started is set immediately before the requests, so uptimeSec is 0; version is the unstamped dev build value
goroutines, heapAllocBytes and numGC are Go runtime values that vary per run

counters_tripped_canary repeats the counters_test.go setup (NewController(0.005, 0.5, 0.0), canary MaxHumanFP 0.10 / ProbationHumans 100000, 400 PassSolved outcomes at 0.9); counters_armed_canary uses NewController(0.005, 0.5, 0.05) with 37 PassSolved outcomes at 0.3
configure_ops sets HMN_OPS_TOKEN with t.Setenv before each configureOps call; can_read_session calls canReadSession with an hsid cookie and Authorization header on GET /api/report/<session>
provenance.scope: Frozen oracle outputs for differential parity only; never regenerate to hide drift
